def by_length(arr):
    if not arr:
        return []
    
    filtered = [num for num in arr if 1 <= num <= 9]
    sorted_filtered = sorted(filtered)
    reversed_filtered = sorted_filtered[::-1]
    
    number_names = ["One", "Two", "Three", "Four", "Five", "Six", "Seven", "Eight", "Nine"]
    result = [number_names[num - 1] for num in reversed_filtered]
    
    return result
